page.title: Data import
page.subtitle: Upload an Excel or CSV file and load it into Keirost through the same validations as if you typed it in.
page.noFile: Go back to the file step: no file has been loaded.

checks.requiredUnmapped: "{field}" is required and no column provides it.
checks.duplicateTarget: Two columns point to "{field}": one would overwrite the other.
checks.chooseMatchBy: Choose which field is used to find the existing record.
checks.matchByUnmapped: You're matching by "{field}", so some column must provide that value.
checks.missingGroupBy: The "{column}" column is missing; it links each header to its {lines}.

object.emptyHint: It depends on the company's active modules and your write permissions.

file.templateHint: Download the {object} template: it includes the columns, a sample row and a sheet describing what each field expects.
file.templateLinesHint: The {lines} go in their own tab of the same file, linked to their header by the "{column}" column.
file.dropLabel: Drag the Excel or CSV file here
file.dropHint: Excel (.xlsx, .xls) or delimited text (.csv, .tsv). Up to 25 MB.
file.oneSheetOnly: This file only has one sheet. {object} needs two: one with the headers and another with the {lines}.
file.noRows: This sheet has no data rows below the header.

mapping.name: Name
mapping.saveHint: Saved for {object}. If you reuse a name, the previous one is overwritten.
mapping.linkHint: Links each header to its lines. Not imported as data.

help.insert: Each row creates a new record. If one with the same key already exists, the row fails.
help.update: Nothing is created: each row looks up an existing record and updates it. A row with no match fails.
help.upsert: If the record exists it's updated; otherwise it's created. The usual choice when reloading a corrected file.

mode.insertOnlyNotice: {object} only supports inserts: its endpoint doesn't allow updates.
mode.matchByHint: That field must be in the file: it's what matches each row with what's already in Keirost.

run.introAfter: first: it goes through the whole file without writing anything and tells you which rows won't make it in.
run.simulationNote: The simulation checks the file: types, required fields, references that don't exist and duplicate keys. The module's own rules (an invalid Tax ID (NIF) format, a credit limit, the numbering series) are applied by {object} when writing, so new errors may appear in the real import.
run.cleanFileHint: No row has format problems. You can now import for real.
run.undoMessage: We'll try to delete the {count} records it created. Those that already have documents or movements attached can NOT be deleted, and you'll be told which ones. Rows that updated something aren't reverted.
run.errorRowsHint: Fix the CSV you can download above and upload it again: it contains only these rows, with the reason in the last column.

history.emptyHint: Each file and its result will be recorded here.
